From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Subject: Catalyst Consulting / Redwood: Integrator sprint & enablement prep

Hi Jana,

Great to connect last week — thanks again for the time. As discussed, we'd like to run a two-day integrator sprint with Catalyst engineering and delivery leads to accelerate a joint demo pack and a playbook your SI team can take to customers. The proposed objectives:

- Get a working end-to-end demo with customer sample data (15–30 min runbook)
- Validate deployment patterns (hosted vs private) and any network restraints
- Produce a 1-page partner playbook and a 3-week enablement plan for your field engineers

Two proposed windows:
- Wed/Thu July 8–9 (preferred by Redwood)
- Tue/Wed July 14–15 (backup)

I attached a draft of the partner playbook and our suggested training syllabus to help frame the agenda (see attachments list below). Could you confirm which window works for your folks, and who from Catalyst should be included on the delivery and security sides?

Next steps from our side if you confirm a date:
1) We’ll finalize the technical lab plan and share environment access instructions.
2) Rishi will schedule a pre-sprint tech scoping call to capture data & network constraints.
3) We’ll send a short MOU (DocuSign) and a HubSpot deal record for mutual action items.

Attachments: Catalyst_Onboarding_Playbook_v0.3.pdf (draft), training-syllabus.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Jana — glad that date works. A couple technical notes from our delivery team:

- Lab topology: we propose a hybrid approach — Redwood-hosted model serving for the demo + an optional VPC-connector session to validate private deployment. This keeps the time-to-demo short while allowing you to test network egress and firewall rules.
- Data: for speed, bring a small CSV/JSON sample (under 10MB) and a single anonymized dataset for the demo run. If you need us to generate synthetic data, we can — let me know.
- Security brief: Naomi and I will produce a one-page evidence summary (SOC 2 scope, retention of logs, KMS options) by Thursday EOD.

I’ve attached a short lab plan outline and a checklist for what we’ll need from Catalyst an hour before the sprint (keys, network contact, sample payloads). Also linking the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleLinkOnboarding — we’ll drop environment scripts there.
